what: Python MVP loop per-event latency budget on the committed real slice (v1.17 F4). Guard: tests/harness/check_mvp_latency_budget.py; measurement: iap.mvp.latency.measure_loop_latency. A budget is a MEASURED CI figure times a margin with its provenance recorded, never a number typed in.

provenance.local_reference: Windows laptop (12 CPUs, detached jobs running) the same day: p50 255 us, p99 3.8 ms

budget.rule: limit = measured x margin, rounded up to a round number; only p50 and p99 are guarded (never p99.9 / max: shared-runner outliers)
